summary.text: Fawn Pedalino is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 64, who assumed office on November 14, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says she was born in Charleston, South Carolina, and lives in Turbeville.

paragraphs.text: Pedalino's career experience includes serving as chief financial officer of Southeastern Technology & Realtor, and she has been affiliated with the Sumter Board of Realtors and the National Association of Realtors, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office on November 14, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists her on the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee and the House Rules Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
